requires.reason: builds the program crate for wasm32
compiles the no_std guest crate and its SDK

structural: the crate is no_std, so the standard library's clocks, threads, sockets and process environment are not linked at all
the SDK never allocates and exposes no allocator, so every buffer is caller-owned and a program carries no ambient authority
the monetary type accepts only sealed unsigned protocol integers, so no floating-point value can be widened into an amount
the artifact rule reuses the runtime's own deterministic-subset validator, so the toolchain and the node cannot disagree
the ABI rule compares the SDK's frozen surface against layerx_programs_runtime, so a stale manifest fails the build
